sources.application: Retain the solved legs/pelvis as foundation, layer torso and cloth drawings, inspect curved spacing and delayed loose fabric, reuse stable identity parts selectively.
A hybrid native test can draw body/cloth while retaining other asset parts. This is a method reference, not a visual style target or evidence that this candidate is good.

sources.application: Separate timed body planning from incidental cloth extremes. Draw a tail extreme between body keys and replace inadequate contours instead of preserving them as fixed extremes.
Inspect downward compression arrest and effort to rise using the bare body before evaluating the coat.
Track visible pelvis/sternum/knee/sole endpoints separately. Do not treat a generic easing curve or event-time match as proof of convincing spacing.
Tie cloth lag to body motion and attachment. The tail should react rather than lead independently; use small, nonuniform response instead of a sine-wave flap.
